comparison_with_stored_notebook_outputs.basis: Stored outputs used Immune_All_Low build 2022-04-04 23:51:15 (90 types, 5212 features, 4715 used). This run used the current index build v2 2022-07-16 00:20:42 (98 types, 6639 features, 5645 used). The current build adds 8 types absent from the old list: Age-associated B cells, Alveolar macrophages, CRTAM+ gamma-delta T cells, Erythrophagocytic macrophages, Intermediate macrophages, Intestinal macrophages, Plasmablasts, Proliferative germinal center B cells (set difference of the two printed model.cell_types arrays, cell 30). Qualitative comparison only.
exact_matches: demo_500 shape (500, 18950) and expm1 row sums (cells 11, 13)
author group sizes: Microglia 60, Macro_pDC 40 (crosstab row sums)
train: '2749 non-expressed genes are filtered out' (cell 70)
custom model cell types: the same 10 types (cell 87)
holds: Best match: Microglia is predicted as a mixture of cell types (cell 46). Now MV: Macrophages 32, DC1 13, Alveolar macrophages 8, pDC 5, Endothelial 1, NMP 1 (stored: Macrophages 31, DC1 14, Naive B 6, pDC 5, DC 2, ...).
Prob match (built-in): Microglia -> Unassigned (cell 59). Now 51/60 Unassigned by majority voting, 57/60 by raw predicted_labels.

Custom model prob match: Microglia -> Unassigned and Macro_pDC -> Macrophages|pDC (cell 81). As-run: Microglia 51/60 Unassigned (MV), Macro_pDC 35/40 Macrophages|pDC (MV), 37/40 raw. Seeded: identical MV counts (51/60, 35/40), raw Macro_pDC 38/40 Macrophages|pDC.

Custom model boxplots (cell 83): Microglia has relatively higher Kupffer cells probability (as-run median 0.069, seeded 0.050, the highest column for Microglia); Macro_pDC has high Macrophages and pDC probabilities (seeded medians 0.997 and 0.99996).

limitations_and_flakiness: Built-in model content depends on the download date. Tests needing exact numbers must load data/Immune_All_Low.pkl (sha256 above) by absolute path, not by name; a name lookup goes through get_all_models() and the cached index.

The ml tutorial's stored built-in-model outputs are from a superseded build; only qualitative agreement is meaningful (see comparison section). Macro_pDC -> Macrophages|pDC does NOT reproduce with the current built-in model; it does reproduce with the custom model.
Unseeded celltypist.train(feature_selection=True) varies run to run (2607/2619/2639 features across the three known runs). Use the seeded reference model for exact tests.

n_jobs changes the seeded model at ~1e-10: random_state=0 with n_jobs=10 twice -> bit-identical; n_jobs=None -> same 2652 features but coef_ max diff 3.1e-11, intercept_ 3.1e-10, annotate probabilities 6.0e-10, labels identical. Bit-equality tests must keep n_jobs=10; otherwise use a tolerance (e.g. 1e-8).
BLAS: OpenBLAS with 20 threads on 20 CPUs. A different core count/BLAS may move low-order bits in LR training and decision scores; label flips would need a probability within ~1e-9 of p_thres=0.5.

Majority voting depends on the neighbour graph: the notebook's prob-match call reuses the graph built by the best-match call on the same AnnData (cell 55 log). A fresh AnnData rebuilds an identical graph in this environment (over_clustering identical in all 5 runs), but scanpy/igraph/leidenalg version changes can alter cluster IDs and majority_voting.

to_adata(insert_prob=True) adds one obs column per model type; 11 of 98 Immune_All_Low names contain '/', so such an AnnData should not be written to h5ad with anndata 0.13 (FutureWarning / ValueError under disallow_forward_slash_in_h5ad). Probabilities are kept in CSV.
Every `import celltypist` emits FutureWarning ('scanpy __version__ is deprecated'); do not run tests with -W error.
Network: demo_2000 download took 258 s (~140 kB/s). Tests should read data/ files, not backup_url.
celltypist_demo_folder/ holds the notebook's own working copies (byte-identical to data/, sha256-checked); .cache/ holds matplotlib/numba/ipython/jupyter-runtime caches redirected into the namespace.
